messages:
Grace - Partnerships: Quick check  we need a short 'Staged Integration Gateway' checklist for new SIs who will go to marketplace + hardware validation. Keep it focused on what's required to pass the integration gate.
Omar - SI Programs: I'll draft the gate criteria: marketplace metadata done, reference deploy verified, hardware compatibility matrix signed, docs linkable. ETA 48h.
Chen - Labs: For reference deploy, we should require a deterministic demo image and a smoke script that can be run by partner and by ops. I'll provide an example in /si-gates/tests/quick-smoke.sh.
Vik - Field Eng: Hardware checks: confirm driver version, quantization profile supported, and a successful model load on the kiosk image. We should capture logs for failure triage.
Lena - PMM: Marketplace copy must include short localized descriptions and a clear "what's included" bulleted list. Also need a single artifact (zip) with install steps.
Grace - Partnerships: Minimal gate checklist draft (copy):
```
1) Marketplace metadata: short desc, screenshots, contact
2) Gate artifact: toolkit.zip (install, scripts, demo image)
3) Reference deploy: pass quick-smoke.sh (ops and partner)
4) Hardware verify: driver + quant profile + test logs
5) Support plan: on-call contact + escalation matrix
6) Legal: partner logo consent on file
```
Omar - SI Programs: Add acceptance criteria: smoke script exit=0, model load <30s, and test logs attached. Also require partner to fill a short verification CSV (name,email,org).
Chen - Labs: I'll supply the smoke script and example output. Ops will run a mirrored test in eu-west. Please instruct partners to name their artifact toolkit_gate_v1.zip.
Vik - Field Eng: If hardware fails, fallback policy: allow listing as "software-only" with disabled kiosk but flag for re-validation. Document the revalidation steps.
Lena - PMM: I'll prepare marketplace template + badge for "Integration Gate Passed". Need final criteria by EOD to work on visuals.
gatekeeper-bot: Scheduled check: "Integration gate draft review" in 24h (3750097511).
Grace - Partnerships: Action owners: Omar=gate criteria + CSV template, Chen=smoke script + example logs, Vik=hardware validate matrix + fallback, Lena=marketplace template + badge, Grace=partner comms + legal checklist. Aim to ship draft to partners in 48h. Flag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
